items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Agdon makes two Branding Iron or Dagger attacks.

items.name: Branding Iron
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target is magically branded. Agdon is invisible to creatures branded in this way. The brand disappears after 24 hours, or it can be removed from a creature or object by any spell that ends a curse.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Quick Fingers
items.notes: Agdon targets one creature within 5 feet of him that he can see and makes a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, with a DC equal to 1 + the target's passive Wisdom (Perception) score. On a successful check, Agdon pilfers one object weighing 1 pound or less that the target has in its possession but not in its grasp, without the target noticing the theft.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: Agdon halves the damage that he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: If Agdon is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if he fails, provided he isn't incapacitated.

items.name: Standing Leap
items.notes: Agdon's long jump is up to 20 feet and his high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Alagarthas makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Unarmed Strike
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Leadership
items.notes: For 1 minute, Alagarthas can utter a special command or warning whenever a nonhostile creature that it can see within 30 feet of it makes an attack roll or a saving throw. The creature can add a d4 to its roll provided it can hear and understand him. A creature can benefit from only one Leadership die at a time. This effect ends if Alagarthas is incapacitated.

items.name: Brave
items.notes: Alagarthas has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Alagarthas has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

items.name: Rapier
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Seed Sling
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Parry
items.notes: Amidor adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Amidor must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

items.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
items.notes: Amidor can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if it shared a language with them.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Bavlorna casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Bavlorna makes one Bite attack and one Withering Ray attack.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Bavlorna can't use her Bite attack on another target.

items.name: Withering Ray
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.

items.name: Create Lornlings
items.notes: Bavlorna creates one or two 1-foot-tall duplicates of herself, called lornlings (use the Quickling stat block in appendix C). Each lornling appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of Bavlorna, obeys her commands, and takes its turn immediately after hers. A lornling lasts for 1 hour, until it or Bavlorna dies, or until Bavlorna dismisses it as an action. Bavlorna can have no more than eight lornlings in existence at a time.

items.name: Swallow
items.notes:
Bavlorna swallows a Small or smaller creature she is grappling, ending the grapple on it. The swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has Cover against attacks and other effects outside Bavlorna, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the swallowed creature is one of Bavlorna's lornlings, Bavlorna gains all the lornling's memories when the acid damage reduces it to 0 hit points.

Bavlorna can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If Bavlorna dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: Bavlorna can breathe air and water.

items.name: Boon of Immortality
items.notes: Bavlorna is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

items.name: Widdershins Allergy
items.notes: If a creature within 10 feet of Bavlorna uses at least 10 feet of movement to run in place counterclockwise, Bavlorna is overcome by a fit of sneezing and can't cast spells until the end of her next turn. In addition, any creature Bavlorna has swallowed is immediately expelled and falls prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of her.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The brigganock casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):

items.name: Pickaxe
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Time Lapse
items.notes: The brigganock accelerates the passage of time around itself, enabling it to accomplish up to 1 hour of work in a matter of seconds. This work can't affect any creature other than the brigganock, or any object being worn or carried by another creature, and the activity must take place within a 10-foot cube. For example, the brigganock could use this action to rapidly carve a pumpkin, cook and eat dinner, move a pile of stones, or tie a dozen knots in a length of rope.

items.name: Move Soul Light
items.notes: The brigganock moves its soul light up to 30 feet in any direction to an unoccupied space it can see. At the end of the current turn, the light returns to the brigganock.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: The brigganock has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put it to sleep.

items.name: Soul Light
items.notes: The brigganock is accompanied by an insubstantial, invulnerable ball of light that contains its soul. The brigganock can't turn off the light or control its brightness. The soul light sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. If the brigganock dies, its soul light fades away.

items.name: Tunneler
items.notes: Using a pickaxe or similar tool, a brigganock can burrow through solid rock at a speed of 5 feet, leaving a 6-inch-diameter tunnel in its wake.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The knight makes two Glaive attacks.

items.name: Glaive
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.

items.name: Croak of Charming
items.notes: The knight makes a loud croak while targeting one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Amphibious
items.notes: The knight can breathe air and water.

items.name: Speak with Frogs and Toads
items.notes: The knight can communicate simple concepts to frogs and toads when it speaks in Bullywug.

items.name: Standing Leap
items.notes: The knight's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

name: Campestri
languages: understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

items.name: Head Butt
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Spores
items.notes: A 5-foot radius of spores extends from the campestri. These spores can go around corners, and they have no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Each other creature in the area must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated and its speed is halved, both for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Mimicry
items.notes: The campestri can mimic any voice or song it has heard, albeit in a nasal falsetto.

items.name: Claws
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.

items.name: Stuffing
items.notes: Clapperclaw stuffs straw or other dead plant matter into itself and regains 2d4 + 2 hit points. Roll a d6; on a 1 or 2, Clapperclaw runs out of stuffing and must spend 8 hours foraging for more before it can use this action again.

items.name: Unsettling Presence
items.notes: Clapperclaw targets one creature it can see within 15 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically frightened until the end of Clapperclaw's next turn.

items.name: Unusual Nature
items.notes: Clapperclaw doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

items.name: Strength Drain
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score is reduced by 1d4. The target falls unconscious if this reduces its Strength to 0. The creature regains consciousness and the reduction to its Strength score disappears after it finishes a short or long rest.

items.name: Amorphous
items.notes: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

items.name: Shadow Stealth
items.notes: While in dim light or darkness, the shadow can take the Hide action as a bonus action. Its stealth bonus is also improved to +6.

items.name: Sunlight Weakness
items.notes: While in sunlight, the shadow has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

items.name: Tentacles
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 bludgeoning damage plus 2 piercing damage.

items.name: Displacement
items.notes: The displacer beast projects a magical illusion that makes it appear to be standing near its actual location, causing attack rolls against it to have disadvantage. If it is hit by an attack, this trait is disrupted until the end of its next turn. This trait is also disrupted while the displacer beast is incapacitated or has a speed of 0.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Elkhorn makes two Dagger or +1 Longsword attacks.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature that is Large or bigger, it takes an extra 5 (1d10) piercing damage.

items.name: +1 Longsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) slashing damage, or 5 (1d10) slashing damage when used with two hands. If the target is a creature that is Large or bigger, it takes an extra 5 (1d10) slashing damage.

items.name: Feint
items.notes: Elkhorn targets one creature that he can see within 5 feet of him. Elkhorn has advantage on the next attack roll he makes against that target before the end of his turn. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage of the weapon's type.

items.name: Second Wind
items.notes: Elkhorn regains 12 hit points.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Elkhorn wields a +1 longsword.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Endelyn casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Endelyn makes two Puppeteer's Lash attacks

items.name: Puppeteer's Lash
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage, and if the target is Large or smaller, Endelyn telekinetically moves it up to 10 feet in any direction horizontally.

items.name: Boon of Immortality
items.notes: Endelyn is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

items.name: Eclipsed Doom
items.notes: Endelyn can be killed only if she is reduced to 0 hit points during a solar eclipse or while she is within 60 feet of a symbolic representation of one. Otherwise, Endelyn disappears in a cloud of inky smoke when she drops to 0 hit points, along with anything she was wearing or carrying, and reappears 24 hours later in the same location or the nearest unoccupied space.

items.name: Uncanny Awareness
items.notes: Endelyn can't be surprised.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

items.name: Claws
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Petrifying Breath
items.notes: Envy exhales petrifying gas in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained target must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends on the target. On a failure, the target is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

items.name: Trampling Charge
items.notes: If Envy moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a bite attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, Envy can make one attack with its claws against it as a bonus action.

items.name: Head Butt
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: If the rocking horse is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the rocking horse move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the rocking horse is animate.

items.name: Flying Mount
items.notes: The rocking horse can serve as a mount for a Medium or smaller creature and can fly only while mounted.

items.name: Unusual Nature
items.notes: The rocking horse doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep, and it regains no hit points or Hit Dice at the end of a long rest.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: The dragonfly halves the damage it takes from an attack made against it, provided it can see the attacker.

items.name: Drone
items.notes: When it beats its wings, the dragonfly emits a loud droning sound that can be heard out to a range of 120 feet.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Shell Defense
items.notes: The snail withdraws into its shell, gaining a +4 bonus to its AC until it emerges. It can emerge from its shell as a bonus action on its turn.

items.name: Salt Osmosis
items.notes: Whenever the snail starts its turn in contact with a pound or more of salt, it takes 1d4 necrotic damage. Using an action to sprinkle a pound of salt on the snail deals 1d4 necrotic damage to it immediately and another 1d4 necrotic damage to it at the start of its next turn (after which the salt rubs off), provided the snail has not withdrawn into its shell.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The swan makes two attacks with its beak.

items.name: Beak
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Keen Sight
items.notes: The swan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

name: Glass Pegasus
languages: Elvish and Sylvan but can't speak

items.name: Hooves
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The golem makes two Glass Sword attacks.

items.name: Glass Sword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage.

items.name: Dazzling Light
items.notes: Magical, colored light springs from the golem in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: If the golem is embedded in a window and motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the golem move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the golem is animate.

items.name: Immutable Form
items.notes: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: The golem regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the golem takes bludgeoning or thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the golem's next turn. The golem is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Unusual Nature
items.notes: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

items.name: Claws
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

items.name: Cloud of Dust
items.notes: On its first turn in combat or when it is reduced to 0 hit points, the cat expels a cloud of dust that acts as dust of sneezing and choking

items.name: Keen Smell
items.notes: The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

items.name: Club
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Sling
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The harengon has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the harengon's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

items.name: Standing Leap
items.notes: The harengon's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

items.name: Club
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit (the target gains no benefit from less than total cover), range 320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. Immediately after making this attack, the harengon can use the Hide action.

items.name: Standing Leap
items.notes: The harengon's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Iggwilv casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24, +16 to hit with spell attacks):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Iggwilv makes two Bewitching Bolt attacks.

items.name: Bewitching Bolt
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d6 + 8) lightning damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Iggwilv until the start of her next turn.

items.name: Abyssal Rift
items.notes: Iggwilv opens a momentary Abyssal rift within 120 feet of her. The rift is a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a DC 22 Constitution saving throw, taking 40 (9d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, there is a 50 percent chance that 3 hezrous then appear in unoccupied spaces in the sphere. They act as Iggwilv's allies, take their turns immediately after hers, and can't summon other demons. They remain until they die or until Iggwilv dismisses them as an action.

items.name: Fey Step
items.notes: Iggwilv teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space she can see within 30 feet of her.

items.name: Negate Spell
items.notes: When Iggwilv sees a creature within 60 feet of her casting a spell, she tries to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a spell using a spell slot of 8th level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a 9th-level spell, it must succeed on a DC 22 Intelligence saving throw, or the spells fails and has no effect.

items.name: Boon of Immortality
items.notes: Iggwilv is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If Iggwilv fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Iggwilv has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. (This trait is bestowed by her robe of the archmagi.)

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Iggwilv wears an amulet of the planes and a robe of the archmagi.

items.name: Witchcraft
items.notes: Iggwilv uses Spellcasting or Fey Step.

items.name: Dark Speech (Costs 2 Actions)
items.notes: Iggwilv utters a phrase in a forbidden language and targets one or two creatures she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target must succeed on a DC 22 Wisdom saving throw or take 11 (2d10) psychic damage and be frightened of Iggwilv for 1 minute. A target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success and thereby becoming immune to Iggwilv's Dark Speech for 24 hours.

items.name: Fey Beguilement (Costs 3 Actions)
items.notes: Iggwilv targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. The target must succeed on a DC 22 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by a fey spirit. While possessed, the target must obey Iggwilv's commands. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, banishing the fey spirit and ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The jabberwock makes two Rend attacks.

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) slashing damage.

items.name: Tail
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Fiery Gaze
items.notes: Unless it is blinded, the jabberwock emits a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line of fire from its eyes. Each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 31 (7d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Confusing Burble
items.notes:
The jabberwock burbles to itself unless it is incapacitated. Any creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the jabberwock and is able to hear its burbling must make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. On a failed saving throw, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn, and it rolls a d4 to determine what it does during its current turn:

1-2: The creature does nothing.

3: The creature does nothing except use all its movement to move in a random direction.

4: The creature either makes one melee attack against a random creature it can see or does nothing if no visible creature is within its reach.

items.name: Legendary Resistance
items.notes: If the jabberwock fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: The jabberwock regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the jabberwock takes slashing damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The jabberwock dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Uncanny Tracker
items.notes: The jabberwock can unerringly track any creature it has wounded in the last 24 hours, and it knows the distance and direction to its quarry as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

items.name: Tail Attack
items.notes: The jabberwock makes one Tail attack.

items.name: Rend Attack
items.notes: The jabberwock makes one Rend attack.

items.name: Wing Attack
items.notes: The jabberwock beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the jabberwock must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone.

items.name: Flail of Locks
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (3d4) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: Jingle Jangle can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of her turns.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Kelek casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Kelek makes three attacks using Sorcerer's Bolt, Staff of Striking, or a combination of them. He can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

items.name: Sorcerer's Bolt
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d12) force damage.

items.name: Staff of Striking
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage, or 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Kelek can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges, dealing an extra 3 (1d6) force damage for each expended charge.

items.name: Fiery Explosion
items.notes: Kelek creates a magical explosion of fire centered on a point he can see within 120 feet of him. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 (10d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Arcane Defense
items.notes: When he is hit by an attack, Kelek protects himself with an invisible barrier of magical force. Until the end of his next turn, he gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Kelek wears bracers of defense and carries a staff of striking with 10 charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If its last charge is expended, roll a d20; on a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff.

name: Kettlesteam the Kenku
languages: understands Auran and Common but speaks only through the use of her Mimicry trait

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Kettlesteam casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Kettlesteam makes two Dagger attacks.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Twilight Sleep
items.notes: Kettlesteam targets one creature she can see within 10 feet of her. The target is engulfed in a cloud of magical, sleep-inducing gas and must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious for 1 minute. A creature put to sleep by this gas awakens instantly if it takes damage, or if someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake.

items.name: Mimicry
items.notes: Kettlesteam can mimic any sounds she has heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check.

items.name: Grabby Hands
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 6) and takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage at the start of each of its turns until this grapple ends. The doll can grapple only one creature at a time.

items.name: Cackle
items.notes: The doll cackles as it targets one or two creatures it can see within 30 feet of it. Each target that can hear the doll's cackling must make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, succeeding automatically if it has an Intelligence of 4 or lower. On a failed saving throw, the creature takes 5 (2d4) psychic damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute as it is overcome by a fit of laughter. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to this doll's Cackle for 24 hours.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: If the doll is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the doll move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the doll is animate.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: The doll regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If the doll takes fire or psychic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the doll's next turn. The doll is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Unusual Nature
items.notes: The doll doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Mercion casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Mercion makes one Divine Radiance attack and one +1 Quarterstaff attack. She can replace one of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

items.name: Divine Radiance
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack Roll: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d8) radiant damage.

items.name: +1 Quarterstaff
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

items.name: Radiant Fire
items.notes: Mercion creates a magical explosion of fiery radiance centered on a point she can see within 120 feet of her. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Mercion wields a +1 quarterstaff.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: While carrying the Witchlight vane, Light casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.name: polymorph
spells.note: after casting, roll a d8; on a roll of 3 or 8, light can't cast the spell again until the next dawn

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Light makes two Witchlight vane attacks.

items.name: Witchlight Vane
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) radiant damage.

items.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
items.notes: Light magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Until the start of his next turn, he appears ghostly and gains resistance to all damage.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Light has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Light carries and is attuned to the Witchlight vane. In Light's hands, the vane is a finesse weapon.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: While carrying the Witchlight watch, Witch casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks):

spells.name: invisibility
spells.note: after casting, roll a d8; on a roll of 3 or 8, witch can't cast the spell again until the next dawn

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Witch makes two Cane attacks.

items.name: Cane
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) necrotic damage.

items.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
items.notes: Witch magically teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Until the start of his next turn, he appears ghostly and gains resistance to all damage.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Witch has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Witch carries and is attuned to the Witchlight watch.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Molliver makes two Dagger or Shortsword attacks, or one of each.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Molliver has advantage on the attack roll or if the target is within 5 feet of one of Molliver's allies.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) piercing damage if Molliver has advantage on the attack roll or if the target is within 5 feet of one of Molliver's allies.

items.name: Levitate
items.notes: While wearing boots of levitation, Molliver casts levitate (self only).

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: Molliver halves the damage they take from an attack made against them, provided they can see the attacker.

items.name: Evasion
items.notes: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Molliver takes no damage on a successful save or half damage on a failed one, provided Molliver is not incapacitated.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Molliver wears +1 leather armor and boots of levitation.

items.name: Sharp Edges
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage.

items.name: Keen Sight
items.notes: The paper bird has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

items.name: Sting
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 piercing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Raezil makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Cunning Action
items.notes: On each of her turns, Raezil can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: Raezil has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.notes: Raezil deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of hers that isn't incapacitated and Raezil doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Ringlerun casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Ringlerun makes three staff of power or Freezing Ray attacks. He can replace one of those attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

items.name: Staff of Power
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (1d8 + 1) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Ringlerun can expend 1 of the staff's charges to deal an extra 3 (1d6) force damage.

items.name: Freezing Ray
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 27 (6d8) cold damage.

items.name: Staff Spell
items.notes: While holding his staff of power, Ringlerun can expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it (spell save DC 14, +8 to hit with spell attacks): cone of cold (8d8 cold damage; 5 charges), fireball (10d6 fire damage; 5 charges), globe of invulnerability (6 charges), hold monster (5 charges), levitate (2 charges), lightning bolt (10d6 lightning damage; 5 charges), magic missile (1 charge), ray of enfeeblement (1 charge), or wall of force (5 charges).

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Ringlerun wields a staff of power. It has 20 charges when fully charged and regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If its last charge is expended, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls but loses its other properties; on a 20, it regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

items.name: Moon Ray
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a bat for 1 minute, as though affected by a polymorph spell. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Sun Ray
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Twin Sight
items.notes: In her mind's eye, a Selenelion twin can see what the other twin sees for up to 1 minute, provided both twins are alive and on the same plane of existence. Maintaining this effect requires concentration (as if concentration on a spell).

items.name: Fey Ancestry
items.notes: The Selenelion twins, Gleam and Glister, have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put them to sleep.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: A Selenelion twin regains 5 hit points at the start of her turn as long as both twins are alive and within 60 feet of each other. A twin dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

items.name: Twin Bond
items.notes: While both Selenelion twins are alive and on the same plane of existence, each is aware of the other's emotions.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Sir Talavar's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast a number of spells, requiring no material components. As the dragon ages and changes color, it gains additional spells as shown below.

items.name: +1 Tiny Sword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

items.name: Euphoria Breath
items.notes: Sir Talavar exhales a puff of euphoria gas at one creature within 5 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, or for 1 minute, the target can't take reactions and must roll a d6 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior during the turn: 1-4: The target takes no action or bonus action and uses all of its movement to move in a random direction. 5-6: The target doesn't move, and the only thing it can do on its turn is make a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Superior Invisibility
items.notes: As a bonus action, Sir Talavar can magically turn invisible until his concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment Sir Talavar wears or carries is invisible with him.

items.name: Limited Telepathy
items.notes: Using telepathy, Sir Talavar can magically communicate with any other faerie dragon within 60 feet of him.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Sir Talavar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Skabatha casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Skabatha makes two Claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) poison damage.

items.name: Alter Size
items.notes: Skabatha magically shrinks herself to Tiny size (between 4 and 8 inches tall) or returns to her normal size. If Skabatha lacks the room to return to her normal size, she attains the maximum size possible in the space available. Anything she is wearing or carrying changes size along with her. As a Tiny creature, Skabatha deals 2 (1d4) poison damage when she hits with a Claw attack. She has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Her statistics otherwise remain unchanged.

items.name: Boon of Immortality
items.notes: Skabatha is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

items.name: Forgetfulness
items.notes: The first creature that Skabatha sees after she finishes a long rest is invisible to her. She can't remember seeing the creature or perceive it using her truesight until the end of her next long rest.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Skylla casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Skylla makes two Eldritch Staff attacks. She can replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

items.name: Eldritch Staff
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Skylla can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges, dealing an extra 4 (1d8) lightning damage for each expended charge.

items.name: Eldritch Escape
items.notes: When Skylla takes damage, she can expend 3 charges of her eldritch staff to turn invisible and teleport, along with any equipment she's wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space she can see. She remains invisible until the start of her next turn or until she attacks or casts a spell.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Skylla carries an Eldritch Staff (see appendix A) with 10 charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If its last charge is expended, roll a d20; on a 1, the staff is destroyed.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Boggle Oil
items.notes: Squirt expends 1 application of boggle oil to create a 10-foot-square puddle of slippery, non-flammable oil on the ground within 5 feet of it. The puddle is difficult terrain and lasts for 1 hour. Each creature that enters the puddle's area or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone. Boggles are unaffected by the oil. After it expends all 3 applications, Squirt can't use this action again until its supply of boggle oil is replenished.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: If Squirt is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed Squirt move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that Squirt is animate.

items.name: Unusual Nature
items.notes: Squirt doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Strongheart casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (DC 13):

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Strongheart makes three Steel attacks.

items.name: Steel
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage when used with two hands. Once on each of his turns, Strongheart can also cause the blade to gleam with holy light. If he does so, the target is blinded until the start of Strongheart's next turn.

items.name: Revivify
items.notes: While holding Steel, Strongheart casts revivify.

items.name: Protect Another
items.notes: When a creature Strongheart can see attacks another creature that is within 5 feet of him, Strongheart can use his reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, provided he is carrying a shield.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Strongheart wields Steel, a sentient, lawful good longsword (see appendix A).

name: Swarm of Campestris
languages: understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait

items.name: Head Butts
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage if the swarm has half its hit points or fewer.

items.name: Spores
items.notes: A 20-foot radius of spores extends from the swarm. These spores can go around corners, and they have no effect on Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Each other creature in the area must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is incapacitated and its speed is halved, both for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Mimicry
items.notes: Each campestri in the swarm can mimic any voice or song it has heard, albeit in a nasal falsetto.

items.name: Swarm
items.notes: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough to accommodate an individual campestri. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Thinnings makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Shortsword
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Change Shape
items.notes: Thinnings can make himself as flat as a piece of parchment or revert to his normal thickness. In his flattened form, he can slide under doors, roll himself up, or even fold himself into the pages of a book.

items.name: Cunning Action
items.notes: On each of its turns, Thinnings can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.notes: Thinnings deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Thinnings that isn't incapacitated and Thinnings doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The tin soldier makes two melee attacks.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
items.notes: The tin soldier is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the tin soldier must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: While the tin soldier remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Rock
items.notes: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Animate Trees
items.notes: The treant magically animates one or two trees it can see within 60 feet of it. These trees have the same statistics as an awakened tree (see the Monster Manual), except they can't speak. An animated tree acts as an ally of the treant. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies, until the treant dies or is more than 120 feet from the tree, or until the treant takes a bonus action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

items.name: False Appearance
items.notes: If the treant is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the treant move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the treant is animate.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Warduke makes three Flame Tongue or Dagger attacks.

items.name: Flame Tongue
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage when used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) fire damage if the weapon is aflame.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

items.name: Flaming Blade
items.notes: Warduke ignites or extinguishes his flame tongue longsword. While aflame, it sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet.

items.name: Second Wind
items.notes: Warduke regains 13 hit points.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Warduke wears a dread helm (see appendix A) and wields a flame tongue longsword.

name: Will-o'-Wells
languages: the languages it knew in life

items.name: Shock
items.notes: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

items.name: Invisibility
items.notes: The will-o'-wells and its light magically become invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).

items.name: Magic Boon
items.notes: The will-o'-wells grants a boon to one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that isn't an Undead. The boon's recipient gains a d4 and can, at any time within the next 24 hours, roll this die and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw made by it. No creature can have more than one of these magic boons at a time.

items.name: Consume Life
items.notes: As a bonus action, the will-o'-wells can target one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the will-o'-wells regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

items.name: Ephemeral
items.notes: The will-o'-wells can't wear or carry anything.

items.name: Incorporeal Movement
items.notes: The will-o'-wells can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

items.name: Variable Illumination
items.notes: The will-o'-wells sheds bright light in a 5 to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of ft. equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wells can alter the radius as a bonus action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The hand casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Pixie Dust
items.notes: The hand sprinkles a pinch of pixie dust on itself or another creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The recipient gains a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 minute. If the creature is airborne when this effect ends, it falls safely to the ground, taking no damage and landing on its feet.

items.name: Secret Expertise
items.notes: The hand has one of these additional skills: Acrobatics acrobatics 6, Animal Handling animal_handling 5, Arcana arcana 5, Athletics athletics 4, Medicine medicine 5, or Performance performance 5.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: The hand casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability:

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Pixie Dust
items.notes: The hand sprinkles a pinch of pixie dust on itself or another creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The recipient gains a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 minute. If the creature is airborne when this effect ends, it falls safely to the ground, taking no damage and landing on its feet.

items.name: Secret Expertise
items.notes: The hand has one of these additional skills: Acrobatics acrobatics 6, Animal Handling animal_handling 5, Arcana arcana 5, Athletics athletics 4, Medicine medicine 5, or Performance performance 5.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Zarak makes two Dagger attacks.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage, plus an extra 5 (2d4) piercing damage if the target is a creature and Zarak has at least 18 hit points.

items.name: Garrote
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Humanoid. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage at the start of each of its turns, and Zarak can't grapple another creature or use Assassin's Whim.

items.name: Assassin's Whim
items.notes: Zarak takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Uncanny Dodge
items.notes: Zarak halves the damage he takes from an attack made against him, provided he can see the attacker.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Zarak carries a potion of invisibility.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.notes: Zargash casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

items.name: Warhammer
items.notes: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands.

items.name: Deathly Ray
items.notes: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

items.name: Animate Corpse
items.notes: Zargash targets the lifeless corpse of one Humanoid he can see within 30 feet of him and commands it to rise, transforming it into a zombie under his control. The zombie takes its turn immediately after Zargash. Animating the zombie requires Zargash's concentration (as if concentration on a spell). The zombie reverts to an inanimate corpse after 10 minutes, when it drops to 0 hit points, or when Zargash's concentration ends.

items.name: Cling to Life
items.notes: The first time Zargash would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, he instead drops to 1 hit point.

items.name: Special Equipment
items.notes: Zargash wears a bat-shaped amulet that has the properties of a ring of feather falling.
